findings.summary: onError returns `maybeError` instead of the resolved `error`, so the single-arg call shape returns `undefined`.
findings.mechanism: When the SDK calls `onError(err)` (single-arg shape), `maybeError` is `undefined` while the resolved value is stored in local `error`. The function logs `error` correctly but returns `maybeError` (undefined) instead of `error`. Since the SDK does `throw this.onError(e)`, this throws `undefined` rather than the real Error, exactly the failure mode the surrounding comment claims to prevent. It also contradicts the newly added test `returns the resolved error for the single-arg shape onError(err)` which asserts `onError(err)` returns `err`.
